# Independent column-order witnesses

Copied byte-for-byte from PR269 head
`850a66b577f03205ad4692d578319e1e7fe95417`, paths
`tests/fixtures/layout_text/semantic-{two,three}.{pdf,txt}`. These are authored
synthetic operator programs with independently handwritten column-major
expectations, not downloaded documents or output generated by this engine.
The original generator, full test/API proposal and history remain preserved
in `archive/20261015-pr269` and the source bundle indexed under
`docs/analysis/backlog-2026-10-15/sources.json`.

Only the two semantic cases are selected here. PR269's separate physical-layout
API and other fixtures remain a distinct preservation obligation. The tests in
`tests/reading_order_columns.rs` exercise the real LopdfBackend, assert no lost
or duplicated spans, and check raw and cleaned token order. They do not establish
general extraction accuracy or paragraph fidelity.
